scope: Derived C23 qualification; original findings table and all app objects unchanged, only tests migrated. Earlier fixture failures remain separately qualified.

findings.baseline_fact: M0 league_intelligence rendered each scalar through the existing available() formatter; the intermediate compact-card support gate instead accepted nonfinite/null-like strings and emitted raw counters.
findings.final_fact: Current display admission reuses the existing formatter and qualifies missing counters. Zero and negative supported values remain visible.
findings.allowed_claim: An intermediate presentation regression was caught and corrected before deployment.
findings.disallowed_claim: A newly discovered production grading, ingestion or upstream-data defect was repaired.

findings.baseline_fact: M0 used FOIS generation pending / preparation pending for waiting; the first overhaul wording said profiles are being prepared for both waiting and running.
findings.final_fact: Only observed running state claims preparation in progress. Waiting/no saved profile says not prepared yet; no generation is started.
findings.allowed_claim: Candidate wording was refined to distinguish waiting from observed active work.
findings.disallowed_claim: Production FOIS workers or admission were defective, or missing profiles were recovered.

findings.baseline_fact: The compact candidate used a 40px wrapper with an inherited 52px fallback.
findings.final_fact: The fallback follows the actual wrapper dimensions, and rendered geometry checks keep it outside player names.
findings.allowed_claim: Visual review caught and corrected an introduced overlap.
findings.disallowed_claim: This repaired a production source-identity or roster-data defect.

findings.baseline_fact: M0 explained that current-owner as-of times are retrieval/sync observations, not acquisition times. An intermediate simplification removed that interpretation.
findings.final_fact: The exact distinction is restored once in optional provenance while the concise visible ownership-gap warning remains.
findings.allowed_claim: Source-clock interpretation was preserved during the presentation migration.
findings.disallowed_claim: Historical ownership time was reconstructed or a new observation clock was obtained.

findings.baseline_fact: The existing phone acceptance threshold was 600px for the first roster action; candidate aggregate explanation exceeded it.
findings.final_fact: The complete coverage explanation follows the roster rows, while compact counts and material named risks remain adjacent.
findings.allowed_claim: The layout was corrected against the unchanged acceptance threshold.
findings.disallowed_claim: The threshold was relaxed or a source-preparation/memory defect was repaired.

global_limits: No newly fixed ingestion/scoring/restoration/provider-acquisition defect is established by this overhaul.
Existing genuine missing/incompatible or not-yet-prepared publications remain qualified.
Unset overall grades and multi-year forecasts are unimplemented models; presentation does not make them available.
Final C14 full local/canonical/hosted acceptance remains pending unless separately reconciled with original receipts.
